source: FEC transaction type code descriptions (fec.gov, Campaign finance data: transaction type codes). Set verified to true after checking this file against the commission's current table.
ruling: 2026-09-17, Fable after /ecc:council. Unlisted codes, memo codes, memo-flagged rows and 24/48-hour notice reports stay visible and out of totals. Form 7 communication costs (24F/24N) are a corporation's or union's own spending, not the PAC's, and stay unsupported. The 20-series (loan repayments, Levin) are not refunds and stay unsupported. Amended filings are not de-duplicated yet.

10.label: Contribution to a Super PAC, hybrid PAC or non-federal account from an individual, partnership or LLC

15.label: Contribution from an individual, partnership or LLC

15E.label: Earmarked contribution from an individual, partnership or LLC

15Z.label: In-kind contribution received from a registered filer

18G.label: Transfer in from an affiliated committee

18K.label: Contribution received from a registered filer (PAC to PAC)

18U.label: Contribution received from an unregistered committee

22Y.label: Contribution refund to an individual, partnership or LLC

22Z.label: Contribution refund to a registered filer

23Y.label: Contribution refund to an unregistered committee

24G.label: Transfer out to an affiliated committee

24K.label: Contribution made to a non-affiliated committee

24P.label: Contribution made to a possible federal candidate, including in-kind

24U.label: Contribution made to an unregistered committee

24Z.label: In-kind contribution made to a registered filer

24E.label: Independent expenditure advocating the election of a candidate

24A.label: Independent expenditure opposing the election of a candidate

excluded_by_ruling.24F: Form 7 communication cost for a candidate: the corporation's or union's own spending, not the PAC's
excluded_by_ruling.24N: Form 7 communication cost against a candidate: the corporation's or union's own spending, not the PAC's
excluded_by_ruling.15J: Memo: recipient committee's share of a joint fundraising contribution
excluded_by_ruling.20R: Loan repayment to a registered filer
